user.title: Add remote bridge resource
user.description: Choose an ESPHome device already known to Home Assistant, or configure another web resource manually.

esphome.title: Add ESPHome device
esphome.description: Select an ESPHome device already configured in Home Assistant. HA Remote Bridge will use its current host and mark the resource as an ESPHome profile.

data_description.esphome_entry_id: Devices already imported into HA Remote Bridge are hidden from this list.

manual.title: Add local web resource
manual.description: Configure a local HTTP or HTTPS resource to access through Home Assistant.

data_description.resource_name: A friendly name for this resource.
data_description.url: The local HTTP or HTTPS URL, for example http://192.168.1.50.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only for local HTTPS services using a self-signed certificate.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

abort.already_configured: This local resource is already configured.
abort.no_esphome_devices: No ESPHome devices are available to import. Add ESPHome devices to Home Assistant first, or all available devices have already been imported.
abort.esphome_device_unavailable: That ESPHome device is no longer available for import.
